_note: HAND-AUTHORED snapshot for full-band-rock (canary Wave 0, run #2). No live capture was performed — this is the chicken-and-egg the brief calls out: a brand-new song from a brief has no prior Live state to capture from. Same friction the solo-piano-ambient runbook step 2 logged; not repeating in detail.
_canary_targets: Audio-track placeholders: 4 tracks declared kind='audio' with no clips. What does push do?

Third-party VST on Keys: hand-authored as 'Spitfire LABS' (a real free VST many users have). Class guessed as 'PluginDevice'. We have NO IDEA what shape the snapshot needs to round-trip through push planning + load — that's a finding.
Repeated sections: verse / chorus appear 2x / 3x in the arrangement. Section identity = (song_id, name) per schema? Or do we need name suffixes?

Sidechain placeholder: lead vocal ducked by drum bus. Modeled here as a Compressor2 device on lead-vocal track with a _note flagging sidechain intent. Push likely can't route the sidechain input — that's a finding.
Master fade-out automation: mixer_volume envelope on the Master track (track_index=0). Does push handle it?
